changes.zh: 将可断行括号填空的括号测宽延迟到文档字体初始化完成后，修复 fontset=none 且在导言区设置中文字体时的全角括号缺字提示和错误宽度。
changes.en: Defer breakable fill-in parenthesis measurement until document fonts are initialized, fixing missing fullwidth parentheses and incorrect cached widths when CJK fonts are configured in the preamble with fontset=none.
